senses.gloss: [to make firm, v. קוֹנָם, קִנָּמוֹן, קִינוּמָא.]
to make a vow of abstinence by using the verb קנם (as a substitute for קוֹנָם, itself a substitute for קָרְבָּן).
units: Ned. 10ᵇ היכי דמי … מְקַנַּמְנָא וכ׳ like what are substitutes of substitutes of vows?… M’ḳannamna, m’ḳannaḥna, m’ḳannasna
